title: ase-3.28.0
body:
* Fix newrelease script to reflect new formatting of release notes
 * Don't build the wheel from the newrelease script since we can use the wheel from the distribution package CI job
 * Move warning configuration to conftest.py since pyproject.toml is not accessible from an installed version, and `ase test` will produce a lot of unnecessary warnings then
 * Move marker configuration likewise
 * Bump version number to 3.28.0, and then to 3.29.0b1

- [ ] [**Unit tests** have been added for new or changed code.](https://ase-lib.org/development/tests.html)

author: askhl

comments.author: askhl
comments.body:
Within an actual installation, the tests are not aware of pyproject.toml and hence the `ase test` command will not ignore all the warnings.  And we have a *lot* of warnings about bad NEB method, old configuration access, etc., which should not be of interest to someone who runs `ase test`.

Maybe we should use conftest for warning control instead of pyproject.toml.

comments.author: askhl
comments.body: Things should be okay now.  I will merge so the web page is updated.
